```{r}
### SI Appendix Fig. S5: Heterogeneity analysis of perceived OHI goal importance.
extdata_fig5_data  <- ohi_estimates_online_eng %>%
    inner_join(
        y = survey_data[ , c("participant_code", "gender", "age", "siblings", "number_moves", "days_at_sea", "ocean_health_importance", "session_label")],
        by = c("participant_code"),
        multiple = "any")
        
# Convert ocean_health_importance to quasi linear numeric variable
extdata_fig5_data <- extdata_fig5_data %>%
    filter(ocean_health_importance != "no opinion") %>% # Remove no opinion responses
    mutate(ocean_health_importance = case_when(
        ocean_health_importance == "not important at all" ~ 1,
        ocean_health_importance == "not important" ~ 2,
        ocean_health_importance == "rather not important" ~ 3,
        ocean_health_importance == "undecided" ~ 4,
        ocean_health_importance == "rather important" ~ 5,
        ocean_health_importance == "important" ~ 6,
        ocean_health_importance == "very important" ~ 7,
    ))

## Alphas and Demographics Quantile Regression
models <- list() # Initialize an empty list for the models

# Add Alpha Regressions
extdata_fig5_data <- extdata_fig5_data %>% 
    mutate(gender = factor(gender, levels = c("male", "female")))

goal_names <- arrange(goal_names, goal_code_eng) # Ensure goal names are in the correct order
for (goal_i in goal_names$goal_code_eng) { # For each goal sort the data and perform a t-test
    current_goal_table <- extdata_fig5_data %>% # This filters the data for the current goal and inverts alpha value if necessary
        filter(str_detect(task_name, goal_i)) %>% 
        mutate(alpha = ifelse(grepl(paste0(goal_i, "-"), task_name), alpha, 1 - alpha),
                goal = goal_i) %>% 
        mutate(task_name = sapply(strsplit(task_name, "-"), function(x) { 
            if (x[1] == goal_i) { # Flips the order of the goals in the task name such that the goal of interest is always first
                return(paste(x, collapse = "-")) 
            } else {
                return(paste(rev(x), collapse = "-"))
            }
        }))

    current_goal_reg <- rq(alpha ~  age +
                                    gender +
                                    days_at_sea +
                                    ocean_health_importance +
                                    session_label, tau = 0.5, current_goal_table)

    models[[goal_i]] <- current_goal_reg
}

# Independent variable Labels
extdata_fig5_labels <- c(
    "(Intercept)" = "Constant",
    "age" = "Age\n(in years)",
```

```{r}
##### SI Appendix Fig. S7
country_correlation_data <- estimates_wcountry %>%
    group_by(country_abrv) %>%
    summarise(
        median_alpha = median(alpha, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_eta = median(eta, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
        y = country_abrv %>%
            distinct(country_abrv, region_name),
        by = "country_abrv"
    ) %>%
    rename(country = region_name) %>%
    filter(country %in% sample_countries) %>%
    left_join(
        y = base_OHI_2022 %>%
            transmute(country = region_name, base_OHI = value),
        by = "country"
    ) %>%
    arrange(country_abrv)

# Panel a: at the goal level, is a goal weighted more where it actually scores higher?
# For each surveyed country and goal, take the median importance weight (alpha_median, the
# normalised per-goal weight from retrieve_alphas(), which sums to 1 across goals) against that
# goal's own 2022 OHI score (goal_score). Both already live per (country, goal) in OHI_table.
# (The previous version correlated each country's *median raw alpha* against the overall country
# OHI; raw alpha is the weight on goal1 within a pair and its median is ~0.5 for every country by
# construction, so no relationship could appear by design.)
goal_alpha_score_data <- OHI_table %>%
    filter(country %in% sample_countries) %>%
    select(country, country_code, goal, goal_score, alpha_median) %>%
    filter(!is.na(goal_score), !is.na(alpha_median))

# The pooled association mixes two channels: a global one (some goals are weighted highly in every
# country and happen to score badly in every country) and a local one (a goal is weighted more in
# those countries where it happens to score badly). Goal fixed effects hold the global channel
# constant, so the remaining slope reflects the local channel alone. We therefore report both: the
# pooled correlation and the within-goal (goal fixed effects) slope.
# Print a very small p-value as "p < 0.001" rather than as a rounded (and misleading) "p = 0.00"
format_p <- function(p) if (p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else sprintf("p = %.2f", p)

alpha_pooled_test <- cor.test(goal_alpha_score_data$alpha_median, goal_alpha_score_data$goal_score,
                              method = "pearson")
alpha_r <- alpha_pooled_test$estimate
alpha_p <- alpha_pooled_test$p.value

alpha_fe_model <- lm(alpha_median ~ goal_score + factor(goal), data = goal_alpha_score_data)
alpha_fe_slope <- coef(alpha_fe_model)[["goal_score"]]
alpha_fe_p     <- summary(alpha_fe_model)$coefficients["goal_score", "Pr(>|t|)"]

# The within-goal partial correlation is just the correlation of the goal-demeaned variables; its
# p-value is the one from the fixed-effects model above, which carries the correct residual df.
alpha_r_within <- goal_alpha_score_data %>%
    group_by(goal) %>%
    mutate(alpha_dm = alpha_median - mean(alpha_median),
           score_dm = goal_score   - mean(goal_score)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    summarise(r = cor(alpha_dm, score_dm)) %>%
    pull(r)

# Anchor the within-goal slope at the grand mean so it can be drawn on the raw (un-demeaned) axes
alpha_fe_intercept <- mean(goal_alpha_score_data$alpha_median) -
                      alpha_fe_slope * mean(goal_alpha_score_data$goal_score)

eta_r <- cor(country_correlation_data$median_eta, country_correlation_data$base_OHI, method = "pearson")

extdata_fig7_theme <- theme_basic +
    theme(
        axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.text.x = element_text(vjust = 6, size = 7),
        axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 1, size = 7),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust = 4, size = 7),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.margin = unit(c(0.2, 0.25, 0.2, 0.1), "cm")
    )

panel_extdata_fig7_alpha <- ggplot(goal_alpha_score_data, aes(x = goal_score, y = alpha_median)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3, color = "#D55E00") +
    geom_abline(intercept = alpha_fe_intercept, slope = alpha_fe_slope,
                linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed", color = "#0072B2") +
    geom_point(size = 1, color = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
    # Annotation colours match the two fitted lines, so the panel needs no legend. Anchored to the
    # top-right corner, which the negative slope leaves empty, and stacked downwards.
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = sprintf("Pooled: r = %.2f (%s)", alpha_r, format_p(alpha_p)), hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.6, size = 7 /.pt, color = "#D55E00") +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = sprintf("Within goal: r = %.2f (%s)", alpha_r_within, format_p(alpha_fe_p)), hjust = 1.05, vjust = 3.1, size = 7 /.pt, color = "#0072B2") +
    labs(
        x = "OHI goal score (2022)",
        y = "Median alpha"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.08))) +
    extdata_fig7_theme

panel_extdata_fig7_eta <- ggplot(country_correlation_data, aes(x = base_OHI, y = median_eta)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3, color = "#D55E00") +
    geom_point(size = 1, color = "black") +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = country_abrv), size = 7 /.pt, color = "black", max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.1, point.padding = 0.0, seed = 1) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = sprintf("Pearson r = %.2f", eta_r), hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.8, size = 7 /.pt) +
    labs(
        x = "OHI score (2022)",
        y = "Median eta"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.08))) +
    extdata_fig7_theme

extdata_fig7 <- ggdraw() +
    draw_plot(panel_extdata_fig7_alpha, x = 0.02, y = 0.03, width = 0.46, height = 0.92, scale = 1) +
    draw_plot(panel_extdata_fig7_eta, x = 0.52, y = 0.03, width = 0.46, height = 0.92, scale = 1) +
    draw_plot_label(c("a", "b"), x = c(0, 0.50), y = c(1, 1), size = 10)

save_plot(filename = here::here("2_Graphs", "SI_Appendix_FigS7.pdf"),
        plot = extdata_fig7,
        base_width = 7.2,
        base_height = 3.2)
```

```{r}
##### SI Appendix Table S1 - Descriptive Statistics
extdata_table_1_data <- survey_data %>%
    filter(participant_code %in% main_sample_subject_selection$participant_code)

# Calculate summary statistics
extdata_table_1 <- extdata_table_1_data %>%
  mutate(session_label = ifelse(session_label == "canada-en" | session_label == "canada-fr", "canada", session_label),
         session_label = str_to_title(session_label)) %>%
  rename(Country = session_label) %>%
  group_by(Country) %>%
  summarize(
    N = n(),
    `Male` = sum(gender == "male"),
    `Female` = sum(gender == "female"),
    `Mean` = mean(age),
    `SD` = sd(age),
    `Min` = min(age),
    `Max` = max(age)
  )

kable(extdata_table_1, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = F, linesep = "\\addlinespace", align = c(rep('l', ncol(extdata_table_1))), digits = 2, 
      col.names = c("Country / Variable", "N", "Male", "Female", "Mean", "SD", "Min", "Max")) %>%
    add_header_above(c(" " = 2, "Gender" = 2, "Age" = 4)) %>%
    save_kable(file = here::here("2_Graphs", "SI_Appendix_TabS1.tex"))
```

```{r}
##### SI Appendix Table S2 - Eta/Alpha values for sample countries, together with the respective goal scores
extdata_tab2_data <- OHI_table %>%
    filter(country %in% c(sample_countries, "Global average")) %>%
    mutate(country_code = ifelse(country == "Global average", "All", country_code),
            eta_median = round(eta_median, 2),
            alpha_median = round(alpha_median, 3)) %>%
    select(country_code, goal, goal_score, eta_median, alpha_median)

extdata_tab2_data <- extdata_tab2_data %>%
  unite(goal_value, goal_score, alpha_median, sep="\n (") %>%
  mutate(goal_value = paste(goal_value, ")", sep="")) %>%
  mutate(goal_value = linebreak(goal_value, align = "l"))

extdata_tab2_data_wide <- extdata_tab2_data %>%
    rename(Eta = eta_median) %>%
    spread(key = goal, value = goal_value) %>%
    transpose(keep.names = "country_code", make.names = "country_code") %>%
    rename(`''` = country_code)

kable(extdata_tab2_data_wide, format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      escape = F,
      linesep = "\\addlinespace", # Increase space between rows
      align = c(rep('l', ncol(extdata_tab2_data_wide)))) %>%
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"), font_size = 8) %>%
    save_kable(file = here::here("2_Graphs", "SI_Appendix_TabS2.tex"))
```
